Name: CropInstantPickup
Author: xingxiX
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
在农作物变成掉落物之前收到背包里，如果背包满了就还是会变成掉落物


因为下载了
[CP] Farming Level Affects Harvest（耕种等级影响作物掉落）
以及LevelExtender（允许技能等级突破到100级的mod）

之后，用拖拉机收个东西变得卡到不行
（尤其是那个蔓越莓我说）
（还有我种满格兰普顿平原的上古水果）

搜了一下有没有能立刻捡起掉落物的mod没搜到
为了不减产又不那么卡于是让AI整了一个

目前测试兼容拖拉机tractor mod以及果树大修Fruit Trees Reforged
多人没测试过，不过我看了一眼代码大概没问题？

[size=4][b]Installation instructions
[/b][/size]使用SMAPI
[color=#D4D4D8]解压然后放到Mods文件夹下[/color]

[b]Requirements[/b]

通用mod配置菜单，可以开关果树是否生效
也就这一个配置就是了（


[b]Description[/b]
Collect crops into the inventory before they turn into dropped items; if the inventory is full, they will still become dropped items.
Because I downloaded:
[list]
[*][CP] Farming Level Affects Harvest[/*]
[*]and LevelExtender (a mod that allows skill levels to exceed 100)[/*]
[/list]After that, harvesting with the tractor became unbearably laggy.
(Especially those cranberries)
(And my ancient fruit planted all over Grampleton Fields.)
I searched for a mod that instantly picks up dropped items but couldn't find one.
So, to avoid reducing yield while also making it less laggy, I had AI put one together.
Currently tested compatible with the Tractor Mod and Fruit Trees Reforged.
Haven't tested multiplayer, but I took a look at the code and it should probably be fine?

[b]Installation instructions:[/b] 
Use SMAPI.
Unzip and place it in the Mods folder.
[b]Requirements:[/b]
Generic Mod Config Menu — lets you toggle whether it applies to fruit trees.
That's the only config, really ( )

Manifest.Name: Crop Instant Pickup
Manifest.Description: 把农作物收获时的掉落物直接放进背包，不再生成满地飞的掉落物。果树可选用 GMCM 开关，原版和模组（如 AFTF）的果树收获都生效。
Manifest.Author: Claude
